# pidginhost_ssh_key (Data Source)

Looks up an SSH key stored in the account by `id`, `alias` or `fingerprint` (exactly one).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  alias = "laptop"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Alias of the key. It must match exactly one key.
- `fingerprint` (String) Fingerprint of the key.
- `id` (String) SSH key ID.

### Read-Only

- `public_key` (String) The public key.
